title: Holiday Hygiene and Toy Drive
time: Drop off any time during business hours, November 20 to December 18
location: Cradle and Kind Baby Boutique (formerly The Baby Depot), 669 Barton Street East, Unit H
details: Cradle and Kind collects donations for local families. Bring unwrapped new toys, petroleum jelly, baby wash, baby lotion, baby shampoo, diaper cream or wipes. The last day to drop off is December 18.

details: Warm meals, gifts, live music and giveaways. For tickets, call 289-389-2308 or 289-775-2119.

title: Hamilton Stands with Ken
location: Hamilton General Hospital, Barton Street East and Victoria Avenue North
details: A show of support for Capt. Kenneth Kunkel, a Canadian Armed Forces member and Cadet Officer who was injured in the line of duty. Meet at 10 am at the Tim Hortons at Barton Street and Ferguson Avenue (parking available), or at Victoria Avenue and Barton Street in front of the hospital. Bring signs of encouragement and flags for your Legion, organization or unit. There will be a Canadian flag to sign for Ken. Everyone is welcome. Questions: Greg Wilkinson, Stoney Creek Legion Service Officer, Wilkinson432@yahoo.ca.
